findings.text: the cadence is computed at selection.py:794, a file outside the dispatch's declared write paths (the order is built in admission ordering, then this result is read at verdicts.py:399), and a concurrent node declares the same path, so the coordinator must ratify it with crew accept-path rather than let it merge as a silent colliding edit.

_seat_share_turns duplicates the deficit round-robin loop the same module already owns at ordering.py:70 weighted_project_order: the same pending/first_seen/servable structure with only the tie rule restated, and the docstring's quota-versus-deficit distinction is not a real difference, because from a zero start the accrual key (k*w - served) is the expression this function computes: the two keys agree seat for seat, so factoring the loop to take a key function would have extended the owner instead of forking it.

IMPLEMENTATION_ROLE is "implementation", but every other surface names that role "implement" (reckon/crew/ticker.py:647; the dispatch default is at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:633), so the verdict row's roles block cannot be joined to a run's role on the implementation side while the change's own review half joins exactly.

the verdict-row case never asserts a launched count, only launched+waiting against the number of requests the test queued, so a role_cadence that reported every request as waiting — launched always 0 — satisfies all four assertions and leaves the plan's "how many it launched" unguarded.

the fragment states "4 distinct run ids were launched", but the verdict log over the stated window carries six launched rows on six distinct run ids (alro-s2, rorp-s3, rorp-s2, rorp-s4, rorp-s5, a-wait-no-sweep-can-lift-reaches-its-coordinator), so a reader counting launches from the record answers four.

the done_when asks for a one-hour reading "before and after", and only the before half is in the record; the fragment says the after half needs the admit service restarted on this code, which is honest but leaves that clause of the measure unmet at this revision.

the evidence_inputs summary repeats the "4 distinct run ids launched" figure and quotes the ninetieth percentile as 7660 s where the fragment says 7664 s and the log yields 7664.2 s at nearest rank, so the manifest's own figures do not reconcile with the record it cites.
